ROW.COLUMN: (ML/EN) Structuring: Deposits/Withdrawals of Mixed Monetary Instruments

This scenario generates an alert when the aggregate number and amount of deposits/withdrawal transactions (for cash and monetary instruments) are higher than specific predetermined thresholds, and the deposits/withdrawals are made into accounts associated with a Customer, Household or External Entity during the Lookback Period.

-- PRIMARY RULE CREDIT --ML_StrDepWDMixedMIs_EN_B_PR with Clndr_vw as ( select (select cal.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cal where cal.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cal.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = @Look_Back_Period - 1) as Min_Dt, (select cal.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cal where cal.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cal.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) as Max_Dt, (select add_days(cal.CLNDR_DT, -@Frequency_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cal where cal.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cal.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) as Freq_Dt, (select k.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.MNTH_BNDRY_CD = 'ED1' and k.CLNDR_NM ='SYSCAL') as Max_Smry_Dt, (select add_months(f_trunc_date(k.CLNDR_DT, 'MM'),-@EN_Smry_Lookback_Period ) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.MNTH_BNDRY_CD = 'ED1' and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') as Min_Smry_Dt FROM dual ),
Wire_Trxn_Vw as (SELECT tr.BENEF_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, tr.SCND_BENEF_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, tr.BENEF_AUG_NM, tr.SCND_BENEF_AUG_NM, tr.BENEF_JRSDCN_CD, tr.SCND_BENEF_JRSDCN_CD, tr.DATA_DUMP_DT, DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) as Trxn_Am, tr.BENEF_ACTVY_RISK_NB, tr.SCND_BENEF_ACTVY_RISK_NB, tr.INTRL_BENEF_ACCT_FL, tr.INTRL_SCND_BENEF_ACCT_FL, (CASE WHEN tr.PASS_THRU_FL='Y' THEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) ELSE 0 END) PASS_THRU_AMT, (CASE WHEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) - TRUNC(DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM), -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) WHEN tr.RCV_TRXN_ACTVY_AM - TRUNC(tr.RCV_TRXN_ACTVY_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) WHEN tr.SEND_TRXN_ACTVY_AM - TRUNC(tr.SEND_TRXN_ACTVY_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) ELSE 0 END) LRF_AMT, case when tr.TRSTD_TRXN_FL = 'Y' then DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) else 0 end as Trusted_Trans_Amt, tr.FUNC_CRNCY_CD, tr.MANTAS_TRXN_CHANL_LOC_ADDR
FROM @MINER@.WIRE_TRXN tr
WHERE (@All_Trans_Src_Fl='Y' OR tr.SRC_SYS_CD IN (@Incl_Trans_Src_Lst)) and DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) >= @Min_Ind_Trans_Amt and DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) <= @Max_Ind_Trans_Amt AND tr.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD in (@Incl_Wire_Trxn_Prdct_Type_Lst) and tr.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' and tr.TRXN_EXCTN_DT >= (select Min_Dt from Clndr_vw) and tr.TRXN_EXCTN_DT <= (select Max_Dt from Clndr_vw) and tr.DATA_DUMP_DT >= (select Min_Dt from Clndr_vw) and tr.DATA_DUMP_DT <= (select Max_Dt from Clndr_vw) and (@Include_Related_Parties_Fl = 'Y' or (tr.UNRLTD_PARTY_FL = 'Y' or tr.UNRLTD_PARTY_FL IS NULL)) and (@Include_B2B_Trnfr_Fl = 'Y' or NOT(tr.BANK_TO_BANK_TRNFR_FL = 'Y' and tr.PASS_THRU_FL = 'N')) and (@Include_Trusted_Trans_FL = 'Y' or COALESCE(tr.TRSTD_TRXN_FL,'N') ='N') and tr.CXL_PAIR_TRXN_INTRL_ID is null ),
Mi_Trxn_Vw as (SELECT tr.BENEF_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, tr.SCND_BENEF_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, tr.BENEF_AUG_NM, tr.SCND_BENEF_AUG_NM, tr.BENEF_JRSDCN_CD, tr.SCND_BENEF_JRSDCN_CD, tr.DATA_DUMP_DT, DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) as Trxn_Am, tr.BENEF_ACTVY_RISK_NB, tr.SCND_BENEF_ACTVY_RISK_NB, tr.INTRL_BENEF_ACCT_FL, tr.INTRL_SCND_BENEF_ACCT_FL, (CASE WHEN tr.PASS_THRU_FL='Y' THEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) ELSE 0 END) PASS_THRU_AMT, (CASE WHEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) - TRUNC(DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM), -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) WHEN tr.CLR_TRXN_ACTVY_AM - TRUNC(tr.CLR_TRXN_ACTVY_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) WHEN tr.DEP_TRXN_ACTVY_AM - TRUNC(tr.DEP_TRXN_ACTVY_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) WHEN tr.ISSUE_TRXN_ACTVY_AM - TRUNC(tr.ISSUE_TRXN_ACTVY_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) ELSE 0 END) LRF_AMT, case when tr.TRSTD_TRXN_FL = 'Y' then DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) else 0 end as Trusted_Trans_Amt, tr.FUNC_CRNCY_CD, tr.MANTAS_TRXN_CHANL_LOC_ADDR FROM @MINER@.MI_TRXN tr
WHERE (@All_Trans_Src_Fl='Y' OR tr.SRC_SYS_CD IN (@Incl_Trans_Src_Lst)) and tr.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' and tr.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD in (@Incl_MI_Trxn_Prdct_Type_Lst) and DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) >= @Min_Ind_Trans_Amt and DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) <= @Max_Ind_Trans_Amt and tr.MANTAS_POST_DT >= (select Min_Dt from clndr_vw) and tr.MANTAS_POST_DT <= (select Max_Dt from clndr_vw) and tr.DATA_DUMP_DT >= (select Min_Dt from Clndr_vw) and tr.DATA_DUMP_DT <= (select Max_Dt from Clndr_vw) and (@Include_Related_Parties_Fl = 'Y' or (tr.UNRLTD_PARTY_FL = 'Y' or tr.UNRLTD_PARTY_FL IS NULL)) and (@Include_B2B_Trnfr_Fl = 'Y' or NOT(tr.BANK_TO_BANK_TRNFR_FL = 'Y' and tr.PASS_THRU_FL = 'N')) and (@Include_Trusted_Trans_FL = 'Y' or COALESCE(tr.TRSTD_TRXN_FL,'N') ='N') and tr.CXL_PAIR_TRXN_INTRL_ID is null ),
All_Trxn_Vw as ( -- WIRE BENE SELECT e.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, e.EXTRL_NTITY_NM, w.BENEF_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID as TRXN_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, w.DATA_DUMP_DT as Dump_Dt, e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB as Efctv_Risk_Lvl, w.Trxn_Am, w.BENEF_ACTVY_RISK_NB as Actvty_Risk_Lvl, w.PASS_THRU_AMT, CASE WHEN w.BENEF_ACTVY_RISK_NB > 0 THEN w.Trxn_Am ELSE 0 END as HR_AMT, w.LRF_AMT, w.Trusted_Trans_Amt, w.FUNC_CRNCY_CD, coalesce(w.MANTAS_TRXN_CHANL_LOC_ADDR, 'NULL') as Loc_Addr
FROM Wire_Trxn_Vw w, @MINER@.EXTERNAL_ENTITY e
WHERE (w.BENEF_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID = e.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID or (w.BENEF_AUG_NM = e.EXTRL_NTITY_NM and w.BENEF_JRSDCN_CD = e.JRSDCN_CD)) and w.INTRL_BENEF_ACCT_FL <> 'Y' --------------------------------------------------------- -- Exclude Exempted External Entity and e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 and e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB >= @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl --Included Jurisdiction Codes and (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' or e.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst))
UNION ALL
-- WIRE SCND BENE SELECT e.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, e.EXTRL_NTITY_NM, w.SCND_BENEF_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID as TRXN_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, w.DATA_DUMP_DT as Dump_Dt, e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB as Efctv_Risk_Lvl, w.Trxn_Am, w.SCND_BENEF_ACTVY_RISK_NB as Actvty_Risk_Lvl, w.PASS_THRU_AMT, CASE WHEN w.SCND_BENEF_ACTVY_RISK_NB > 0 THEN w.Trxn_Am ELSE 0 END as HR_AMT, w.LRF_AMT, w.Trusted_Trans_Amt, w.FUNC_CRNCY_CD, coalesce(w.MANTAS_TRXN_CHANL_LOC_ADDR, 'NULL') as Loc_Addr
FROM Wire_Trxn_Vw w, @MINER@.EXTERNAL_ENTITY e
WHERE (w.SCND_BENEF_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID = e.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID or (w.SCND_BENEF_AUG_NM = e.EXTRL_NTITY_NM and w.SCND_BENEF_JRSDCN_CD = e.JRSDCN_CD)) and w.INTRL_SCND_BENEF_ACCT_FL <> 'Y' -- include transaction record where SCND_BENE <> BENE and (w.INTRL_BENEF_ACCT_FL ='Y' or ( -- looking at second orig ID, make sure it's not same as orig ID (e.EXTRL_NTITY_NM is null and COALESCE(w.BENEF_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, -1) <> w.SCND_BENEF_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID) or -- looking at second orig Name, make sure it's not same as orig name (e.EXTRL_NTITY_NM is not null and (COALESCE(w.BENEF_AUG_NM, '-') <> w.SCND_BENEF_AUG_NM or COALESCE(w.BENEF_JRSDCN_CD,'-') <> w.SCND_BENEF_JRSDCN_CD)))) --------------------------------------------------------- -- Exclude Exempted External Entity and e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 and e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB >= @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl --Included Jurisdiction Codes and (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' or e.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst))
UNION ALL -- MI BENE SELECT e.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, e.EXTRL_NTITY_NM, m.BENEF_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID as TRXN_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, m.DATA_DUMP_DT as Dump_Dt, e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB as Efctv_Risk_Lvl, m.Trxn_Am, m.BENEF_ACTVY_RISK_NB as Actvty_Risk_Lvl, m.PASS_THRU_AMT, CASE WHEN m.BENEF_ACTVY_RISK_NB > 0 THEN m.Trxn_Am ELSE 0 END as HR_AMT, m.LRF_AMT, m.Trusted_Trans_Amt, m.FUNC_CRNCY_CD, coalesce(m.MANTAS_TRXN_CHANL_LOC_ADDR, 'NULL') as Loc_Addr
FROM Mi_Trxn_Vw m, @MINER@.EXTERNAL_ENTITY e
WHERE (m.BENEF_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID = e.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID or (m.BENEF_AUG_NM = e.EXTRL_NTITY_NM and m.BENEF_JRSDCN_CD = e.JRSDCN_CD)) and m.INTRL_BENEF_ACCT_FL <> 'Y' --------------------------------------------------------- -- Exclude Exempted External Entity and e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 and e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB >= @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl --Included Jurisdiction Codes and (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' or e.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst))
UNION ALL -- MI SCND BENE SELECT e.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, e.EXTRL_NTITY_NM, m.SCND_BENEF_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID as TRXN_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, m.DATA_DUMP_DT as Dump_Dt, e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB as Efctv_Risk_Lvl, m.Trxn_Am, m.SCND_BENEF_ACTVY_RISK_NB as Actvty_Risk_Lvl, m.PASS_THRU_AMT, CASE WHEN m.SCND_BENEF_ACTVY_RISK_NB > 0 THEN m.Trxn_Am ELSE 0 END as HR_AMT, m.LRF_AMT, m.Trusted_Trans_Amt, m.FUNC_CRNCY_CD, coalesce(m.MANTAS_TRXN_CHANL_LOC_ADDR, 'NULL') as Loc_Addr
FROM Mi_Trxn_Vw m, @MINER@.EXTERNAL_ENTITY e
WHERE (m.SCND_BENEF_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID = e.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID or (m.SCND_BENEF_AUG_NM = e.EXTRL_NTITY_NM and m.SCND_BENEF_JRSDCN_CD = e.JRSDCN_CD)) and m.INTRL_SCND_BENEF_ACCT_FL <> 'Y' -- include transaction record where SCND_BENE <> BENE and (m.INTRL_BENEF_ACCT_FL ='Y' or ( -- looking at second orig ID, make sure it's not same as orig ID (e.EXTRL_NTITY_NM is null and COALESCE(m.BENEF_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, -1) <> m.SCND_BENEF_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID) or -- looking at second orig Name, make sure it's not same as orig name (e.EXTRL_NTITY_NM is not null and (COALESCE(m.BENEF_AUG_NM, '-') <> m.SCND_BENEF_AUG_NM or COALESCE(m.BENEF_JRSDCN_CD,'-') <> m.SCND_BENEF_JRSDCN_CD)))) --------------------------------------------------------- -- Exclude Exempted External Entity and e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 and e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB >= @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl --Included Jurisdiction Codes and (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' or e.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst))
UNION ALL
-- Cash Credit SELECT e.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, e.EXTRL_NTITY_NM, c.CNDTR_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID as TRXN_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, c.DATA_DUMP_DT as Dump_Dt, e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB as Efctv_Risk_Lvl, DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',c.TRXN_FUNC_AM,c.TRXN_BASE_AM) as Trxn_Am, c.CASH_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB as Actvty_Risk_Lvl, 0 as PASS_THRU_AMT, (CASE WHEN c.CASH_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB > 0 THEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',c.TRXN_FUNC_AM,c.TRXN_BASE_AM) ELSE 0 END) HR_AMT, (CASE WHEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',c.TRXN_FUNC_AM,c.TRXN_BASE_AM) - TRUNC(DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',c.TRXN_FUNC_AM,c.TRXN_BASE_AM), -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',c.TRXN_FUNC_AM,c.TRXN_BASE_AM) WHEN c.TRXN_ACTVY_AM - TRUNC(c.TRXN_ACTVY_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',c.TRXN_FUNC_AM,c.TRXN_BASE_AM) ELSE 0 END) LRF_AMT, 0 as Trusted_Trans_Amt, c.FUNC_CRNCY_CD, coalesce(c.MANTAS_TRXN_CHANL_LOC_ADDR, 'NULL') as Loc_Addr
FROM @MINER@.CASH_TRXN c, @MINER@.EXTERNAL_ENTITY e
WHERE (c.CNDTR_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID = e.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID or (c.CNDTR_AUG_NM = e.EXTRL_NTITY_NM and c.CNDTR_JRSDCN_CD = e.JRSDCN_CD)) -- Bug 33835409 and c.DBT_CDT_CD = 'D' and (@All_Trans_Src_Fl='Y' OR c.SRC_SYS_CD IN (@Incl_Trans_Src_Lst)) and c.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' and c.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD in (@Incl_Cash_Trxn_Prdct_Type_Lst) and DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',c.TRXN_FUNC_AM,c.TRXN_BASE_AM) >= @Min_Ind_Trans_Amt and DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',c.TRXN_FUNC_AM,c.TRXN_BASE_AM) <= @Max_Ind_Trans_Amt and c.TRXN_EXCTN_DT >= (select Min_Dt from Clndr_vw) and c.TRXN_EXCTN_DT <= (select Max_Dt from Clndr_vw) and c.DATA_DUMP_DT >= (select Min_Dt from Clndr_vw) and c.DATA_DUMP_DT <= (select Max_Dt from Clndr_vw) and c.CXL_PAIR_TRXN_INTRL_ID is null -- Exclude Exempted External Entity and e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 and e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB >= @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl --Included Jurisdiction Codes and (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' or e.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst)) ),
All_Trxn_Fin as( SELECT t.Extrl_Ntity_Seq_Id, t.Trxn_Extrl_Ntity_Seq_Id, t.Dump_Dt, t.Efctv_Risk_Lvl, t.Trxn_Am, t.Actvty_Risk_Lvl, t.Hr_Amt, t.Lrf_Amt, t.Pass_Thru_Amt, t.Trusted_Trans_Amt, t.FUNC_CRNCY_CD, t.Loc_Addr, case when t.EXTRL_NTITY_NM is not null then COALESCE(t.Trxn_Extrl_Ntity_Seq_Id, rownum) else null end as Other_Id, case when t.EXTRL_NTITY_NM is null then 1 else 0 end as Id_Driven, case when t.EXTRL_NTITY_NM is not null and t.Trxn_Extrl_Ntity_Seq_Id is null then 1 else 0 end as Nm_Driven FROM All_Trxn_Vw t ),
REPEATING_NOTREPEATING AS ( SELECT EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, CASE WHEN ( SUM ( (CASE WHEN @Incl_Wire_Trns_Fl ='Y' THEN COALESCE(WIRE_TRXN_IN_CT,0)+ COALESCE(WIRE_TRXN_OUT_CT,0) ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN @Incl_Mi_Trns_Fl ='Y' THEN COALESCE(MI_TRXN_IN_CT,0)+ COALESCE(MI_TRXN_OUT_CT,0) ELSE 0 END ) + (CASE WHEN @Incl_Cash_Trns_Fl ='Y' THEN COALESCE(CASH_TRXN_IN_CT,0)+ COALESCE(CASH_TRXN_OUT_CT,0) ELSE 0 END) ) >= @Min_EN_Trns_Ct AND SUM ( (CASE WHEN @Incl_Wire_Trns_Fl ='Y' THEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',WIRE_TRXN_IN_FUNC_AM,WIRE_TRXN_IN_AM)+ DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',WIRE_TRXN_OUT_FUNC_AM,WIRE_TRXN_OUT_AM) ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN @Incl_Mi_Trns_Fl ='Y' THEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',MI_TRXN_IN_FUNC_AM,MI_TRXN_IN_AM)+ DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',MI_TRXN_OUT_FUNC_AM,MI_TRXN_OUT_AM) ELSE 0 END ) + (CASE WHEN @Incl_Cash_Trns_Fl ='Y' THEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',CASH_TRXN_IN_FUNC_AM,CASH_TRXN_IN_AM) + DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',CASH_TRXN_OUT_FUNC_AM,CASH_TRXN_OUT_AM) ELSE 0 END) ) >= @Min_EN_Trns_Amt ) THEN 'R' ELSE 'N' END AS EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL FROM @MINER@.EXTRL_NTITY_SMRY_MNTH ensm WHERE ensm.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT <= (select Max_Smry_Dt from clndr_vw) and ensm.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT > (select Min_Smry_Dt from clndr_vw) GROUP BY EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID )
--MAIN QUERY-- SELECT tr.Extrl_Ntity_Seq_Id , 'Credit' as Activity_Fl , max(tr.Efctv_Risk_Lvl) as Efctv_Risk_Lvl , max(tr.Actvty_Risk_Lvl) as Actvty_Risk_Lvl , sum(tr.Hr_Amt) as Hr_Am , sum(tr.Pass_Thru_Amt) as Pass_Thru_Am , sum(tr.Lrf_Amt) as Lrf_Am , sum(tr.Trxn_Am) as Trans_Amt , count(1) as Trans_Ct , sum(tr.Trusted_Trans_Amt) as Trusted_Trans_Amt , max(tr.FUNC_CRNCY_CD) as FUNC_CRNCY_CD , count(distinct tr.Loc_Addr) as Lctn_Ct , coalesce (r.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL, 'N') as EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL
FROM All_Trxn_Fin tr, REPEATING_NOTREPEATING r
WHERE tr.Extrl_Ntity_Seq_Id = r.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID (+)
GROUP BY tr.Extrl_Ntity_Seq_Id, r.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL
HAVING -- Frequency Period max(tr.dump_dt) > (select Freq_Dt from Clndr_vw) and max(tr.dump_dt) <= (select Max_Dt from Clndr_vw) -- applying constraints and count(1) >= case when coalesce (r.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL, 'N') = 'R' then @Min_Trans_Ct else @NR_Min_Trans_Ct end and count(1) <= case when coalesce (r.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL, 'N') = 'R' then @Max_Trans_Ct else @NR_Max_Trans_Ct end and sum(tr.Trxn_Am) >= case when coalesce (r.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL, 'N') = 'R' then @Min_Trans_Amt else @NR_Min_Trans_Amt end and sum(tr.Trxn_Am) <= case when coalesce (r.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL, 'N') = 'R' then @Max_Trans_Amt else @NR_Max_Trans_Amt end and count(distinct tr.Loc_Addr) >= case when coalesce (r.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL, 'N') = 'R' then @Min_Lctn_Ct else @NR_Min_Lctn_Ct end -- ID_DRIVEN logic and (sum(tr.Id_Driven) = count(1) or count(distinct tr.Other_Id) > 1 or (sum(tr.Nm_Driven) = 1 and count(1) = 1))

--WIRE CREDIT --ML_StrDepWDMixedMIs_EN_B_Wire with Clndr_vw as ( select (select cal.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cal where cal.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cal.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = @Look_Back_Period - 1) as Min_Dt, (select cal.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cal where cal.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cal.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) as Max_Dt FROM dual ),

WHERE (c.CNDTR_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID = e.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID or (c.CNDTR_AUG_NM = e.EXTRL_NTITY_NM and c.CNDTR_JRSDCN_CD = e.JRSDCN_CD)) -- Bug 33835409 and c.DBT_CDT_CD = 'C' and (@All_Trans_Src_Fl='Y' OR c.SRC_SYS_CD IN (@Incl_Trans_Src_Lst)) and c.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' and c.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD in (@Incl_Cash_Trxn_Prdct_Type_Lst) and DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',c.TRXN_FUNC_AM,c.TRXN_BASE_AM) >= @Min_Ind_Trans_Amt and DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',c.TRXN_FUNC_AM,c.TRXN_BASE_AM) <= @Max_Ind_Trans_Amt and c.TRXN_EXCTN_DT >= (select Min_Dt from Clndr_vw) and c.TRXN_EXCTN_DT <= (select Max_Dt from Clndr_vw) and c.DATA_DUMP_DT >= (select Min_Dt from Clndr_vw) and c.DATA_DUMP_DT <= (select Max_Dt from Clndr_vw) and c.CXL_PAIR_TRXN_INTRL_ID is null -- Exclude Exempted External Entity and e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 and e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB >= @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl --Included Jurisdiction Codes and (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' or e.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst)) ),
All_Trxn_Fin as( SELECT t.Extrl_Ntity_Seq_Id, t.Trxn_Extrl_Ntity_Seq_Id, t.Dump_Dt, t.Efctv_Risk_Lvl, t.Trxn_Am, t.Actvty_Risk_Lvl, t.Hr_Amt, t.Lrf_Amt, t.Pass_Thru_Amt, t.Trusted_Trans_Amt, t.FUNC_CRNCY_CD, t.Loc_Addr, case when t.EXTRL_NTITY_NM is not null then COALESCE(t.Trxn_Extrl_Ntity_Seq_Id, rownum) else null end as Other_Id, case when t.EXTRL_NTITY_NM is null then 1 else 0 end as Id_Driven, case when t.EXTRL_NTITY_NM is not null and t.Trxn_Extrl_Ntity_Seq_Id is null then 1 else 0 end as Nm_Driven FROM All_Trxn_Vw t ),
REPEATING_NOTREPEATING AS ( SELECT EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, CASE WHEN ( SUM ( (CASE WHEN @Incl_Wire_Trns_Fl ='Y' THEN COALESCE(WIRE_TRXN_IN_CT,0)+ COALESCE(WIRE_TRXN_OUT_CT,0) ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN @Incl_Mi_Trns_Fl ='Y' THEN COALESCE(MI_TRXN_IN_CT,0)+ COALESCE(MI_TRXN_OUT_CT,0) ELSE 0 END ) + (CASE WHEN @Incl_Cash_Trns_Fl ='Y' THEN COALESCE(CASH_TRXN_IN_CT,0)+ COALESCE(CASH_TRXN_OUT_CT,0) ELSE 0 END) ) >= @Min_EN_Trns_Ct AND SUM ( (CASE WHEN @Incl_Wire_Trns_Fl ='Y' THEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',WIRE_TRXN_IN_FUNC_AM,WIRE_TRXN_IN_AM)+ DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',WIRE_TRXN_OUT_FUNC_AM,WIRE_TRXN_OUT_AM) ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN @Incl_Mi_Trns_Fl ='Y' THEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',MI_TRXN_IN_FUNC_AM,MI_TRXN_IN_AM)+ DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',MI_TRXN_OUT_FUNC_AM,MI_TRXN_OUT_AM) ELSE 0 END ) + (CASE WHEN @Incl_Cash_Trns_Fl ='Y' THEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',CASH_TRXN_IN_FUNC_AM,CASH_TRXN_IN_AM) + DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',CASH_TRXN_OUT_FUNC_AM,CASH_TRXN_OUT_AM) ELSE 0 END) ) >= @Min_EN_Trns_Amt ) THEN 'R' ELSE 'N' END AS EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL FROM @MINER@.EXTRL_NTITY_SMRY_MNTH ensm WHERE ensm.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT <= (select Max_Smry_Dt from clndr_vw) and ensm.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT > (select Min_Smry_Dt from clndr_vw) GROUP BY EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID )
--MAIN QUERY-- SELECT tr.Extrl_Ntity_Seq_Id , 'Debit' as Activity_Fl , max(tr.Efctv_Risk_Lvl) as Efctv_Risk_Lvl , max(tr.Actvty_Risk_Lvl) as Actvty_Risk_Lvl , sum(tr.Hr_Amt) as Hr_Am , sum(tr.Pass_Thru_Amt) as Pass_Thru_Am , sum(tr.Lrf_Amt) as Lrf_Am , sum(tr.Trxn_Am) as Trans_Amt , count(1) as Trans_Ct , sum(tr.Trusted_Trans_Amt) as Trusted_Trans_Amt , max(tr.FUNC_CRNCY_CD) as FUNC_CRNCY_CD , count(distinct tr.Loc_Addr) as Lctn_Ct , coalesce (r.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL, 'N') as EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL
FROM All_Trxn_Fin tr, REPEATING_NOTREPEATING r
WHERE tr.Extrl_Ntity_Seq_Id = r.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID (+)
GROUP BY tr.Extrl_Ntity_Seq_Id, r.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL
HAVING -- Frequency Period max(tr.dump_dt) > (select Freq_Dt from Clndr_vw) and max(tr.dump_dt) <= (select Max_Dt from Clndr_vw) -- applying constraints and count(1) >= case when coalesce (r.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL, 'N') = 'R' then @Min_Trans_Ct else @NR_Min_Trans_Ct end and count(1) <= case when coalesce (r.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL, 'N') = 'R' then @Max_Trans_Ct else @NR_Max_Trans_Ct end and sum(tr.Trxn_Am) >= case when coalesce (r.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL, 'N') = 'R' then @Min_Trans_Amt else @NR_Min_Trans_Amt end and sum(tr.Trxn_Am) <= case when coalesce (r.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL, 'N') = 'R' then @Max_Trans_Amt else @NR_Max_Trans_Amt end and count(distinct tr.Loc_Addr) >= case when coalesce (r.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL, 'N') = 'R' then @Min_Lctn_Ct else @NR_Min_Lctn_Ct end -- ID_DRIVEN logic and (sum(tr.Id_Driven) = count(1) or count(distinct tr.Other_Id) > 1 or (sum(tr.Nm_Driven) = 1 and count(1) = 1))

--WIRE DEBIT --ML_StrDepWDMixedMIs_EN_R_Wire with Clndr_vw as ( select (select cal.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cal where cal.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cal.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = @Look_Back_Period - 1) as Min_Dt, (select cal.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cal where cal.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cal.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) as Max_Dt FROM dual ),
